title: feat(spec): JSX-source page kind + Command Center showcase (ADR-0080)
body:
Implements the **spec** side of ADR-0080 + a showcase example.

- **`PageSchema`**: `kind: 'jsx'` + `source` (authoritative JSX text, compiled to the tree at save time) + `requires`, with a completeness `superRefine` — a jsx page with no `source` fails loudly (ADR-0078). `full`/`slotted` pages unchanged.
- **app-showcase**: `command-center-jsx.page.ts` — a polished home page authored entirely as constrained JSX + Tailwind source. **Browser-verified** rendering through the objectui runtime (objectstack-ai/objectui#2056).

Verified: `safeParse` accepts jsx+source, rejects jsx without source on path `source`; full/slotted unaffected.

> Release ordering: the showcase page renders once objectui ships the `kind:'jsx'` runtime (#2056). The spec change + page are independently spec-valid.
